name: bharat-choropleth-workspace
description: Open-source, accessible India state-to-district choropleth components.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter bharat-choropleth build && pnpm --filter bharat-choropleth-js build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter bharat-choropleth test && pnpm --filter bharat-choropleth-js test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter bharat-choropleth typecheck && pnpm --filter bharat-choropleth-js typecheck && pnpm --filter @bharat-choropleth/demo exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm --filter @bharat-choropleth/parity-demo exec tsc --noEmit
scripts.check: pnpm build && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build:demo && pnpm validate:data
scripts.check:flutter: cd packages/flutter && flutter analyze && flutter test
